drivers: Four attributes to track (count, shape, fill, rotation) with different rule types, high working-memory load
Count progression 3-2-1 and shape/fill distribution-of-three are familiar, learnable rules
Rotation rule (decreasing 45° per row to upright) is the least salient and visually hard with triangles/pentagons; many distractors differ only on rotation or fill
105 s is adequate for systematic elimination; all options share the correct shape so chance is effectively higher than 1/8
